opening.argument: The speaker presents LitVM as a Litecoin-related Web3 technology and explains its proposed capabilities, including smart contracts and cross-chain interoperability. A whiteboard reinforces those technical points, while the discussion of DeFi protocols, stablecoins, NFT platforms, and payment rails identifies possible applications. Those references remain part of a technology presentation, not a request for viewers to participate in an investment or take another required action. Nothing in the supplied material describes a request for payment or credentials, and it does not claim that viewers will receive a financial outcome.

citations.quote: today i want to tell you about lit vm aka litecoin's web three era
little vm is a zero knowledge omni chain solution built on top of litecoin in order to allow for smart contract functionalities cross-chain interoperabilities and web3 features
